cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Carry This with Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Take half Mum's care-home forms. Being her children can't mean I'm the paperwork child.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then sit beside me. I'll explain, and you can write.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. It asks for one main contact.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put yourself. I'll help with every answer, but Mum needs to know she can reach either of us.

mechanism: A uses its greater expertise as an ongoing teacher to bring its sibling into shared care work instead of accepting unequal family responsibility.
confusable: Not merely giving a lesson: the goal is shared responsibility required by their relationship.
comparison: Family paperwork shared through teaching versus joint decisions about relationship letters.
seedUse: D77 original already uses explanation/writing and ongoing help as its method; retain with fidelity reservation.
